enrichment.directorySummary: Web-presentation leaf delegated by the parent search command within the file-operations family — isolates DOM/CSS generation from ripgrep execution, filtering and CLI/text adaptation in the parent. Stateless rendering-only layer invoked via the parent's web adapter path (not directly via the file dispatcher), consuming grouped results to produce interactive UI while reusing shared workspace breadcrumb/timeline infrastructure for navigation consistency.

files.stylesheet.ts: Style-only companion to web.ts in the delegated rendering leaf — isolates declarative CSS from rendering logic, defining search-specific classes consumed solely by renderFileSearchWeb and importing shared breadcrumb/timeline styles to maintain visual consistency across file-plugin web renderers.
files.web.ts: Web renderer entry that consumes the parent command's grouped result model and translates it into interactive navigation — bridges breadcrumb header/open-timeline actions and per-match view buttons to workspace file-view navigation by path and line number, completing the parent's dual-mode (CLI text vs web) contract.
